nodes.label: Consolidate on Virtual Threads (Drop Dual-Mode)
nodes.rationale: Finding 1: Maintaining bit-perfect parity between Spring MVC (Virtual Threads) and WebFlux doubles development/testing effort. High-performance systems benefit from specialization. Java 25's Virtual Threads make blocking model performant without Reactive's cognitive load.

nodes.label: AIC Lag Selection Loop Bottleneck
nodes.rationale: Finding 2: AIC loop making up to 10 REST calls per symbol/metric pair creates N*10 REST call explosion. Proposal: push AIC loop into Python worker; use Arrow IPC or gRPC instead of REST/JSON.

nodes.label: Proxy Divergence Guard
nodes.rationale: Finding 3: T-Bill yields often drop while SOFR spikes during Flight-to-Quality events. If T-Bill yield trend moves >2 std dev away from 5-day SOFR/T-Bill correlation, flag ILI as DISLOCATED and suppress automated signals.

nodes.label: Real-Time Aggregates (materialized_only = false)
nodes.rationale: Finding 4: TimescaleDB Continuous Aggregate end_offset leaves most recent minute invisible. Enable Real-Time Aggregates by setting materialized_only=false.

nodes.label: Dynamic Weighting for NaN Components
nodes.rationale: Finding 6: Zero Variance Guard defaults Z-scores to 0.0 which masks stale data as healthy. Instead return NaN and redistribute weight proportionally; set ILI status to DEGRADED_COMPONENT_STALE.

nodes.label: Stabilize Critical Path with Direct Java Clients
nodes.rationale: Finding 5: OpenBB v4 provider-heavy model may introduce breaking changes. Implement direct lightweight Java clients for FRED and NY Fed API for core ILI components.
